name: ysainson
description: Yann's personal plugin marketplace: the VIBE build pipeline. A vibe-coding surface (one command, fast) over a disciplined core - test-first builds, model-tiered doers, mandatory review of every diff, and an independent fresh-context verifier. The VIBE core plus per-stack overlays, updated from one place.

plugins.name: vibe
plugins.description: Disciplined, model-adaptive build pipeline disguised as vibe coding: idea -> brief -> scaffold -> test-first build, where every diff is reviewed and a fresh-context verifier signs off before anything is called done. It looks like vibe coding; it's the opposite.

plugins.name: vibe-swift
plugins.description: VIBE overlay for Swift / macOS: concurrency, testability, and signing/notarization guardian agents, plus the Swift scaffold knowledge /vibe:setup uses. Depends on the re-exported swiftui-expert and swift-testing-expert skills.

plugins.name: vibe-expo
plugins.description: VIBE overlay for Expo / React Native, phones only: UI-performance, testability, release, and accessibility guardian agents, plus the Expo scaffold knowledge /vibe:setup uses. Depends on the re-exported expo, callstack-react-native, swmansion-react-native, vercel-react-native, and emil-animate-expo skills; via the expo dependency it also auto-loads Expo's hosted MCP server (https://mcp.expo.dev/mcp).

plugins.name: superpowers
plugins.description: Re-exported and pinned: obra/superpowers - the agentic SDLC phase engine the VIBE conduct skill wraps (brainstorming, writing-plans, subagent-driven-development, test-driven-development, code review, finishing-a-development-branch).

plugins.name: swiftui-expert
plugins.description: Re-exported and pinned: AvdLee/SwiftUI-Agent-Skill - expert SwiftUI guidance for state, composition, performance, and Liquid Glass. A vibe-swift dependency.

plugins.name: swift-testing-expert
plugins.description: Re-exported and pinned: AvdLee/Swift-Testing-Agent-Skill - expert Swift Testing guidance (#expect/#require, traits, parameterization, XCTest migration). A vibe-swift dependency.

plugins.name: expo
plugins.description: Re-exported and pinned: expo/skills - Official Expo skills for building, deploying, upgrading, and debugging Expo apps. Ships a .mcp.json pointing at the hosted https://mcp.expo.dev/mcp MCP server, which auto-loads for consumers. A vibe-expo dependency.

plugins.name: callstack-react-native
plugins.description: Re-exported and pinned: callstackincubator/agent-skills - react-native-best-practices (performance: FPS/TTI/bundle/memory). A vibe-expo dependency.

plugins.name: swmansion-react-native
plugins.description: Re-exported and pinned: software-mansion-labs/skills - react-native-best-practices (New-Architecture patterns: Reanimated/worklets/Fabric). A vibe-expo dependency.

plugins.name: vercel-react-native
plugins.description: Re-exported and pinned: vercel-labs/agent-skills - vercel-react-native-skills (React Native / Expo best practices; not vercel-react-best-practices, which is Next.js/web). A vibe-expo dependency.

plugins.name: emil-animate-expo
plugins.description: Re-exported and pinned: emilkowalski/skills - the animate-expo skill only (React Native / Expo animation craft: Reanimated v4 worklets, gesture handoff, springs, haptics). A vibe-expo dependency.

plugins.name: emil-design-eng
plugins.description: Re-exported and pinned: emilkowalski/skills - Emil Kowalski's full design-engineering collection (animation craft and audits, Apple-design-for-web, UI library picks, prototyping, Sonner). Web-focused; optional and never auto-installed - no VIBE plugin depends on it; install per project where you do web/UI design work. The Expo-specific animate-expo skill also ships separately as a vibe-expo dependency.

plugins.name: codex
plugins.description: Re-exported and pinned: openai/codex-plugin-cc - OpenAI's official Codex plugin (managed app-server broker, /codex:review, /codex:adversarial-review, background job control, /codex:setup auth story). Optional cross-model overlay: requires the Codex CLI and an OpenAI login; not a dependency of any VIBE plugin. Ships SessionStart/SessionEnd hooks and a Stop-hook review gate that is OFF by default; VIBE never enables it. Model policy: cross-checks run at the consumer's codex-configured model (VIBE requests high reasoning effort explicitly where the invocation path allows); see README for setup guidance.
